notes.title: Guilty Parade Episode 4: The Underside of the Past is out!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35940776/6f1956d4f159b23ea45bdffe03e39fa58cd21764.png

Guilty Parade Episode 4: The Underside of the Past is out!

Many thanks to everyone who was eagerly waiting for the release, we are sorry that it was delayed due to problems with the release of the new build. The problem has now been resolved.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2290390/Guilty_Parade_Episode_4/

FAQ:

❓ Is this a sequel to Episode 4: The Underside of the Future?
No, this is an alternate route after Episode 3. Your decisions in Episodes 1-3 affect which route you end up on (the Underside of the Past or The Underside of the Future).

❓ Do I have to buy Episode 4: The Underside of the Past separately?
It comes bundled with Episode 4: The Underside of the Future. If you already have Episode 4 in your library, there is no need to purchase this route separately, just update the game.

Attention! Due to the engine and code major update, some saves may show an error. To avoid it try to load an earlier save file and skip the read dialogs (use Shift + > to fast skip). You can report a bug to our mail: NozoriGames@gmail.com. We apologize for the inconvenience and hope for your understanding!

Thanks for your support and enjoy!
Noasaki and Orizori

notes.title: Notice for Windows 32-bit
notes.content:
Due to the game engine latest update and removed support of 32-bit versions, we have uploaded a new build for players who cannot run Guilty Parade on their 32-bit devices.

How to enable it:

 Open your Steam Library
 Right-click on the game title from the left list and select "Properties..."
 In the opened window, click the "Betas" tab
 In the input window, enter the code "windows32bit" (without quotes) and click "Check Code"
 Click the blue button "Join: 32-bit for Windows 32-bit"
 In the drop-down list above, select the option "32-bit For Windows 32-bit"
 Please wait for the game to update, and then you can run Guilty Parade by clicking the "Play" button in your library.


Enjoy!

Nozori Games

notes.title: Guilty Parade in a Minute
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35940776/b3cd72f18f818c1de5b7b0cad0d7f7d6f007ac01.png


Guilty Parade is an interactive Visual Novel with Point & Click elements.

You play both as Nemo and Lien and look at an obscure war from different sides of barricades:

Nemo. A guy with amnesia. Under the Commander’s protection, he joins a squad of young soldiers to spy and then investigate a crime.
Lien. A child of war. He leads a completely different life in fear of being killed by black apostates and with desire to avenge the death of a dear person.


Main Features:

 Secret investigation of the mysterious crime and searching for clues in Point & Click mode
 The opportunity to build strong friendship bonds with quirky characters
 A lot of meaningful choices
 Cinematic effects and dynamic narration


In the Demo of Guilty Parade, the first episode (out of five) is presented, where you meet all the main characters of the game. Its full walkthrough is about three hours.

Do not forget to add the game to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1167170/Guilty_Parade/

[previewyoutube=nAt0NRkEC2E;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: The Development Details of Guilty Parade
notes.content:
We, Nozori Games, are developing an interactive visual novel with point-and-click elements Guilty Parade (GP). We would like to tell about the plot and the game development.

The desire to create our own game appeared a long time ago, but the concrete idea of  GP came across our mind about 3 years ago and finally formed in mid-2018. In the beginning, it was planned as a classic short ADV visual novel. But working on the plot we decided that the story required scope both in events and characters.

This story is primarily about people. The world they live in is not as simple as it might seem at first glance, and the characters have their secrets.

So what about the universe of GP? It is an alternate post-apocalyptic world in the beginning of the 20th century. Due to the environmental disaster associated with the pole shift, most of the glaciers had melted, so vast areas of the earth ended up underwater. A war broke out between the survived people about which the main character Nemo does not remember anything. You have to solve some riddles to disclose the biggest intrigue of the visual novel.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35940776/c79eea407bfb4670d132abdc97eb8c4de3c5bfb2.png

We did not try to make the characters ideal, on the contrary, they have many weaknesses, partly comic, partly tragic. Everyone has their own quirk, their habits and demeanour are unpredictable. Hope you will like someone!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35940776/42e6a716e277bbd835cd59ca43c27729b879ec4f.png

Playing the game, you decide which side in the military conflict to support. At the moment, there are 3 routes in the game, but the events based on your choices (including the revealing of the characters’ backgrounds) vary greatly. You can learn everything about their biography and personality if you show great curiosity and persistence. We would also like to note that sometimes your mistakes help to discover secrets and solve some riddles faster.

Last year we also released the demo version (about 3+ hours of play). Feel free to download it on Steam!
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35940776/a6a8f7df7c1c98b8c7bd3b86800e50e95fb156ff.png
 
Our small team consists of only 2 people:

 Noasaki – a scriptwriter, an environmental artist;
 Orizori – a character artist, a programmer.


Our responsibilities are divided conditionally, almost everything we do together by discussing the characters’ design, CG, locations and main events.

Usually, it takes 6-7 hours a day to work on the game. Sometimes we have a productive day, sometimes we procrastinate for a long time, fall into despair when we realize how much remains to be done, sometimes we work with enthusiasm. From time to time, we have crunches, for example, before the demo release, we deprived ourselves of sleep to meet the deadline. In a word, the days go by differently but working on such a huge project as GP is a tedious and monotonous task. However, we always look at the results of our painstaking work with pride and satisfaction.

Follow us on Twitter where we regularly publish artworks, comics, conduct polls, share interesting stuff and post the development progress.
 
Thanks for your attention!
 
Nozori Games
